# Problem 1 — NY NOAA
## Import and describe the dataset
```{r}
data("ny_noaa")

dim(ny_noaa)

ny_noaa |>
  summarize(
    across(
      c(prcp, snow, snwd, tmax, tmin),
      ~ mean(is.na(.x)) * 100
    )
  ) |>
  kable(digits = 1)
```
### Dataset description
The NY NOAA dataset contains `r nrow(ny_noaa)` observations and `r ncol(ny_noaa)` variables from `r n_distinct(ny_noaa$id)` weather stations in New York State. Each row represents a weather observation at a specific station on a particular date. The dataset includes station ID, date, precipitation (`prcp`), snowfall (`snow`), snow depth (`snwd`), maximum temperature (`tmax`), and minimum temperature (`tmin`).

Missing data are an important issue. Approximately `r round(100 * mean(is.na(ny_noaa$tmax)), 1)`% of maximum temperature observations and `r round(100 * mean(is.na(ny_noaa$tmin)), 1)`% of minimum temperature observations are missing. The missing percentages are `r round(100 * mean(is.na(ny_noaa$prcp)), 1)`% for precipitation, `r round(100 * mean(is.na(ny_noaa$snow)), 1)`% for snowfall, and `r round(100 * mean(is.na(ny_noaa$snwd)), 1)`% for snow depth. This may affect comparisons across stations and years.
